content: Expo SDK 57 FileSystem API (new and legacy) exposes no NSUrlIsExcludedFromBackupKey / iCloud-backup-exclusion option; expo-sqlite DB in Documents and MMKV in Application Support are included in iCloud device backups by default. OS backups are encrypted and user-controlled and do not count as data collection for privacy labels, but they technically contradict an absolute 'data never leaves the device' claim; setting the flag requires a custom config plugin/native tweak.
